configurations.name: dimmi-web-only
runtimeArgs: go build -o tmp/dimmi-web ./cmd/dimmi && DIMMI_HTTP__ADDR=127.0.0.1:8095 DIMMI_HTTP__ADMIN_ADDR= DIMMI_APP__ROLES=web DIMMI_APP__URL=http://localhost:8095 tmp/dimmi-web serve

configurations.name: dimmi-gate-preview
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env.testing; set +a; go build -o tmp/dimmi-gate ./cmd/dimmi && DIMMI_DATABASE__URL="${DATABASE_URL%/postgres*}/dimmi_demo?sslmode=disable" DIMMI_REDIS__URL="$REDIS_URL" DIMMI_APP__KEY="base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" DIMMI_GATE__ENABLED=true DIMMI_GATE__PASSWORD=preview DIMMI_HTTP__ADDR=127.0.0.1:8096 DIMMI_HTTP__ADMIN_ADDR= DIMMI_APP__ROLES=web DIMMI_APP__URL=http://localhost:8096 tmp/dimmi-gate serve

configurations.name: dimmi-local-preview
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env.testing; set +a; go build -tags cloud -o tmp/dimmi-local ./cmd/dimmi && DIMMI_DATABASE__URL="${DATABASE_URL%/postgres*}/dimmi_preview?sslmode=disable" DIMMI_REDIS__URL="$REDIS_URL" DIMMI_APP__KEY="base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" DIMMI_APP__ENV=local DIMMI_FRONTEND__HOT_PATH=tmp/no-hot DIMMI_HTTP__ADDR=127.0.0.1:8097 DIMMI_HTTP__ADMIN_ADDR= DIMMI_APP__URL=http://localhost:8097 tmp/dimmi-local serve
